category: Archive and Protect Each Software Release (PS)
subcategory_text: Archive each released software version with its complete toolchain, configuration, and source so that the artefact can be reproduced or analysed later (e.g., for vulnerability remediation or audit).
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AU-10, CM-4, SA-15
implementation_examples: Maintain versioned archives of every released artefact for at least the supported-lifetime of the release
Include the build manifest and toolchain versions in the archive
Protect archives with restricted access and integrity verification
assessment_objectives: Determine whether each release is archived with sufficient provenance to enable reproduction.
Determine whether archives are protected from unauthorised modification.
